Nora: Heads-up: spotted duplicate billing callbacks from onboarding sample when a long streaming generate hit a 429 during auth rotation + an upstream proxy that auto-retried 502/503. The stream had already emitted a small chunk (partial side-effect), then client retry + proxy retry produced a second webhook.

Ben: Yikes. So three actors: client retry, proxy retry, and token rotation. That’s an annoying combo. Which SDKs?

Nora: Node and Rust sampleapps. Rust SDK currently doesn't inject an idempotency header by default. Node quickstart also lacks it in the streaming example.

Sofia: Do we have logs? Particularly headers for the requests that caused the duplicate webhook.

Nora: snippets: 
```
# original request headers (before token rotate)
Authorization: Bearer tok-old
User-Agent: sampleapp-rust/0.2.0
# no X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key

# retry that hit after proxy re-route
Authorization: Bearer tok-new
Via: kong-proxy/2.1 (retries=1)
```

Ben: Two mitigation tracks: 1) Client-side: always generate and attach X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key per logical op for HTTP/long-poll flows. For streaming, the SDK should emit a per-session resume token so clients can resume instead of full replay. 2) Infra: server dedupe by op-id + replay-guard header and make proxy respect idempotency headers to avoid opaque retries.

Sofia: Also parity notes: parse Retry-After as float; clamp to min 100ms; prefer full jitter/backoff. Rust SDK needs updates to match Node/Go/Python.

Ben: Proposed minimal backoff (full jitter):
```js
function backoff(attempt, base=150){
  const cap = 15000;
  const raw = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * raw);
}
// if Retry-After present: delay = Math.max(parsedRetryAfter*1000, backoff(attempt))
```

Nora: For streams where partial output can trigger side-effects (webhook/payment), we should add an opt-in header X-Redwood-Stream-Resume: nonce which the server returns with a resume cursor. Client retries then include resume cursor to continue instead of repeating side-effects. This avoids full replay for long-running ops.

Sofia: Agree. Also we must update quickstart snippets: show adding idempotency header for HTTP, show resume-token handling for streaming, and call out proxies that may auto-retry.

DevX Bot: Docs draft: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries (section "proxy retries + partial streams") and issue RD-9433 created for SDK parity and resume-token feature.

infra-bot: Note: kong proxy config PR suggested - disable automatic 5xx retries for /v1/generate path, or forward X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key to upstream for safe retries. PR: https://infra.redwood/pull/546

Ben: Action items: (1) Rust SDK: add automatic X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key for HTTP flows (Sofia) (2) Node quickstart: add idempotency example + streaming resume example (Nora) (3) infra: change proxy behavior to honor idempotency and avoid blind retries (infra team) (4) server: add resume cursor support + replay-guard checks (backend team) (5) tests: integration simulating proxy retries + token rotate (qa).

Nora: I'll add a tiny PR to sampleapp and paste a reproducible script for QA. Will also run staging with proxy retries disabled to confirm drop in duplicates.

Sofia: I'll start a Rust SDK patch and open RD-9433 subtask for unit tests.

Nora: thanks all, will report back after staging run :raised_hands:
